_note: Learned host→handler map for lib/fetch-jd.mjs. Machine-grown via `node lib/fetch-jd.mjs --learn ...`, NOT hand-edited by the user. Committed on purpose: it is accumulated fetch wisdom that should pass to whoever picks this up next, not per-user state. Each entry maps an otherwise-unrecognised host (or regex) to one of the built-in handlers in fetch-jd.mjs, plus any params the handler can.t pull from the URL (e.g. an org/tenant slug). Consulted before the built-in URL matchers.

entries.note: proxify.io careers page is Teamtailor; job IDs in path match jobs.proxify.io/jobs/{id}-*
Weaviate careers page embeds Ashby job board; ?ashby_jid={uuid} maps to api.ashbyhq.com/posting-api/job-board/weaviate
ongig front-end over Greenhouse board; ongig job id == gh job id

Deel custom ATS (Next.js SPA). No __NEXT_DATA__, but embeds full JobPosting JSON-LD in page head — xh GET + python3 JSON-LD extraction works. URL pattern: /deel/job-details/{uuid}/overview. No auth required.
Squarespace careers page fronting Greenhouse board for Slice (pizzeria platform)

SAP SuccessFactors Jobs2Web (j2w) static HTML. xh GET + HTML extraction works (no JS rendering needed). URL shape: /job/{slug}/{job-id}-{locale}/. Redirects from external IDs (e.g. 1398845233) to internal id-locale form (99061-en_GB). No JSON-LD. Needs a j2w handler in fetch-jd.mjs for zero-token support.
